subject: Unpacking observability tiering and commit incentive
messages:
From: Alice Romero <alice@datavine.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: DataVine Procurement <procurement@datavine.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — retention / tracing / dashboards (pricing ask)

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the earlier overview. We need to make a decision this quarter on how to structure observability spend for our LLM infra — specifically:

- Separate line items for trace retention (30/90/365 day buckets) and advanced dashboards (per-seat vs org-level).
- Pricing that lets us choose to opt-in to dashboards later without a big upfront surcharge.
- A commitment discount if we sign an 18-month contract and commit to a visible minimum (baseline ingest + dashboards seats).

Can you share an unbundled price table (retention by TB/month, trace ingest perM, dashboards per-seat and org tier) and any flexibility on early-commit incentives? Procurement is the decision owner here (cc'd).

Also can you include any pilot credits or migration assistance? That will affect our procurement thresholds.

Appreciate a crisp breakdown — we have a procurement review 11/30.

Best,
Alice
Alice Romero
Director, Platform Engineering
DataVine

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Romero <alice@datavine.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — retention / tracing / dashboards (pricing ask)

Hi Alice — thanks, got it. Quick summary of how we recommend structuring this so procurement has clear options:

1) Unbundled list (high level):
   - Trace ingest: $0.09 per ingested GB (volume tiers at 10TB, 50TB, 200TB)
   - Retention buckets: 30-day (included), 90-day (+$0.02/GB-month), 365-day (+$0.06/GB-month)
   - Advanced dashboards: $25 per named seat / month OR $3,000 org-tier per month (up to 500 users)
   - Cross-product discount: packaged tier available if you commit to both retention and dashboards (see incentives below)

2) Early-commit incentives (example):
   - 12-month: 5% off list for retention & dashboards
   - 18-month: 10% off list + two months free dashboard seats (applied as credits across first 6 months)
   - Pilot: up to $20k credits against trace ingest for a 6-week pilot (applied to first invoice)

3) Migration assistance: one month of professional services (migration runbook + onboarding) included for contracts ≥ 12 months; additional SOW rates apply.

I attached a concise pricing sheet (Redwood_OBS_pricing_v3.pdf) and a sample SOW draft that maps scope to the DV deal (DataVine_SOW_draft.docx).

If that framing looks useful I can propose a specific priced quote (itemized invoice) for the procurement review on 11/30. If procurement prefers a blended org price instead of per-seat, we can produce that too but will need a committed headcount.

Would you like a one-pager with the 18-month incentive spelled out to show to your procurement committee?

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Team — forwarding DataVine's procurement timing (proc review 11/30). They want an unbundled table + an 18-month commit incentive. Proposed concession: 10% off retention & dashboards for 18 months, plus two months of dashboard seats credit (applied pro-rata over first 6 invoices) and $15k ingest credit for pilot (we can fund from pilot pool).

Margin impact: approx 9% effective reduction on ARR for the first 18 months (models in attached spreadsheet). If we push back on org-tier discount we can protect margin but may slow procurement.

Can we get approval to offer the 10% concession with the pilot credits? If finance wants to limit credits, we can reduce pilot to $10k. Ben — do you need a revised sample invoice (I can generate) and the incremental P&L? Marcus — will engineering need to sign-off on the migration month PSP?

Thanks — need final thumbs before EOD so we can send the 18-month incentive one-pager to DataVine tomorrow morning.

Laura

Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — retention / tracing / dashboards (pricing ask)

Hi Alice — appreciate the timelines. Per internal approvals we've put together two clean options below so procurement can pick the path that best matches DataVine's appetite for flexibility vs. unit economics.

Option A — Unbundled / Flex-first (no long-term commit):
 - Trace ingest: $0.09 / ingested GB (tiered discounts at 10TB / 50TB / 200TB)
 - Retention: 30d included; 90d +$0.02 / GB-month; 365d +$0.06 / GB-month
 - Dashboards: $30 / named seat / month OR $3,500 / org-tier / month (up to 500 users)
 - Pilot credit: $10,000 applied to first invoice
 - Migration: one month of onboarding included
 - No long-term discount applied

Option B — 18-month commit (preferred for blended savings):
 - Same unit prices as above
 - 18-month commitment to baseline ingest + dashboards minimum (baseline defined in SOW)
 - 10% off retention and dashboard line items (applied to monthly invoice)
 - Two months of dashboard seats credited across the first six invoice cycles (converted to a $ value and applied as invoice credit)
 - $15,000 pilot credit applied to the first invoice
 - One month of professional services (migration) included

Next steps:
 - If you prefer Option B we will issue an amended SOW and a priced sample invoice before EOD Monday (11/30) so procurement has a clean doc for review.
 - If you prefer per-seat flexibility we can convert the org-tier to a usage-based cap for the first 6 months.

Link: HubSpot deal (DV-8721) — https://app.hubspot.com/deal/8721. I attached the pricing summary and the SOW draft for review.

If these options look reasonable, can you confirm which procurement packet you want for the 11/30 review (Option A / Option B)? Happy to jump on a 20-min call tomorrow to walk the committee through it.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
